name: Walrus Pump Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1967 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Walrus Pump Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the full lifecycle of water pumps, from initial research and development through to manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service. For residential applications, their extensive product range features innovative antimicrobial electronic control, automatic booster, and direct water pumps, as well as conventional electronic control, automatic flow-controlled, hot water, multistage centrifugal, and atomizing models. The company's industrial offerings include self-priming, multistage centrifugal (both standard and vertical configurations), immersible, and coolant pumps. Additionally, Walrus Pump caters to commercial needs with its constant pressure inverter control systems.
